options.description: The gateway process: listener, worker directory and drain (the gateway also requires the tls option).
options.name: core

settings.description: PRAGMATIC_HOST: Address the listener binds.
settings.name: host

settings.description: PRAGMATIC_PORT: Port the listener binds.
settings.name: port

settings.description: PRAGMATIC_REDIS_URL: The Redis URL of the worker directory.
settings.name: redisUrl

settings.description: PRAGMATIC_WORKER_SERVERNAME: TLS server name of the workers.
settings.name: workerServerName

settings.description: PRAGMATIC_DRAIN_TIMEOUT_MS: How long shutdown waits for connections to drain, in milliseconds.
settings.name: drainTimeoutMs

settings.description: PRAGMATIC_HEALTH_PORT: Separate port for /healthz and /readyz (served on the main listener when unset).
settings.name: healthPort

options.description: Mutual TLS between the gateway and the workers (the server side).
options.name: tls

settings.description: PRAGMATIC_TLS_CERT_FILE: Path of the PEM certificate this process presents.
settings.name: certificateFile

settings.description: PRAGMATIC_TLS_KEY_FILE: The PEM private key of that certificate (a mounted secret file).
settings.name: privateKey

settings.description: PRAGMATIC_TLS_CA_FILE: Path of the PEM CA bundle peers are verified against.
settings.name: caFile

options.description: The client certificate this process presents when it connects to another cluster member.
options.name: clientTls

settings.description: PRAGMATIC_CLIENT_TLS_CERT_FILE: Path of the PEM client certificate.
settings.name: certificateFile

settings.description: PRAGMATIC_CLIENT_TLS_KEY_FILE: The PEM private key of the client certificate (a mounted secret file).
settings.name: privateKey

settings.description: PRAGMATIC_CLIENT_TLS_CA_FILE: Path of the PEM CA bundle the server is verified against.
settings.name: caFile

settings.description: PRAGMATIC_SERVICE_NAME: The service name reported with metrics and traces.
settings.name: serviceName

settings.description: PRAGMATIC_METRICS_PORT: Port of the Prometheus metrics listener (off when unset).
settings.name: metricsPort

settings.description: PRAGMATIC_OTLP_ENDPOINT: OTLP collector endpoint (no export when unset).
settings.name: otlpEndpoint

settings.description: PRAGMATIC_OTLP_PROTOCOL: OTLP protocol: http-protobuf or grpc.
settings.name: otlpProtocol

settings.description: PRAGMATIC_OTLP_METRICS: Whether metrics are also exported over OTLP.
settings.name: otlpMetrics

settings.description: PRAGMATIC_TRACE_SAMPLING: Trace sampling ratio between 0 and 1.
settings.name: traceSampling

settings.description: PRAGMATIC_AUDIT_SINK: none or file (the gateway has no SQL audit store).
settings.name: sink

settings.description: PRAGMATIC_AUDIT_FILE: The audit file (required for sink file).
settings.name: file

options.description: Request rate limits, each an Rps + Burst pair.
options.name: rateLimit

settings.description: PRAGMATIC_RATELIMIT_ENVIRONMENT_RPS: Requests per second per environment (a number greater than 0).
settings.name: environmentRps

settings.description: PRAGMATIC_RATELIMIT_ENVIRONMENT_BURST: Burst per environment (at least 1).
settings.name: environmentBurst

settings.description: PRAGMATIC_RATELIMIT_PRINCIPAL_RPS: Requests per second per principal (a number greater than 0).
settings.name: principalRps

settings.description: PRAGMATIC_RATELIMIT_PRINCIPAL_BURST: Burst per principal (at least 1).
settings.name: principalBurst

options.description: WebSocket heartbeat, idle and back-pressure limits.
options.name: webSocket

settings.description: PRAGMATIC_WS_HEARTBEAT_MS: Heartbeat interval in milliseconds.
settings.name: heartbeatMs

settings.description: PRAGMATIC_WS_READ_IDLE_MS: A connection silent for this many milliseconds is closed.
settings.name: readIdleMs

settings.description: PRAGMATIC_WS_BP_SOFT_BYTES: Buffered bytes at which a slow connection is paused.
settings.name: backpressureSoftBytes

settings.description: PRAGMATIC_WS_BP_HARD_BYTES: Buffered bytes at which a slow connection is closed.
settings.name: backpressureHardBytes

settings.description: PRAGMATIC_WS_BP_GRACE_MS: How long a connection may stay over the soft limit, in milliseconds.
settings.name: backpressureGraceMs

settings.description: PRAGMATIC_WS_MAX_INBOUND_BYTES: Largest inbound message in bytes.
settings.name: maxInboundBytes
